tasks.title: Add Always-Valid Constructors to Domain Models
tasks.requirements: Add validating constructors (returning (*T, error)) to Rule, TransactionValidation, and AuditEvent models per PROJECT_RULES.md Always Valid Domain Model pattern
acceptance_criteria: All 3 constructors return (*T, error) instead of *T
All constructors validate inputs before construction
Defensive copies created for slice parameters
No invalid states can be constructed
All callers updated to handle errors
Unit tests pass

tasks.title: Add Mutation Methods to Rule Model
tasks.requirements: Add Rule.Update() and Rule.SetStatus() methods following validate-before-mutate pattern per PROJECT_RULES.md
acceptance_criteria: Rule.Update() validates all before mutating any (no partial mutations on error)
Rule.Update() creates defensive copies of slices
Rule.SetStatus() enforces state machine transitions
Rule.SetStatus() maintains timestamp invariants
Command layer uses domain methods instead of direct field access
Unit tests verify no-mutation on validation failure

tasks.title: Refactor ValidationRequest to Use Constructor Pattern
tasks.requirements: Add NewValidationRequest() constructor to prevent invalid state construction per PROJECT_RULES.md anti-patterns
acceptance_criteria: ValidationRequest cannot be created in invalid state
Constructor normalizes inputs (currency uppercase, trim whitespace)
Constructor creates defensive copies of scopes and metadata
Handlers use constructor instead of struct literal + Validate() call
No regression in validation behavior

tasks.title: Remove Direct OTel Imports

acceptance_criteria: Zero import 'go.opentelemetry.io/otel/trace' in application code (except pkg/logging/trace.go and test files)
All 12 files use lib-commons tracer interface
Observability behavior unchanged (verified via Jaeger)
Unit tests pass
Integration tests pass
